excluded.docs/INDEX.md, docs/catalog/**, docs/cou: generated navigation and counts; rebuildable from canonical data
excluded..cache/**, exports/**, SQLite, media/aud: derived or restored working copies; verify media separately
excluded.preservation/manifests/**: baselines are versioned separately to avoid self-reference
excluded.preservation/checks/*.jsonl: append-only fixity events are maintained separately from the file baseline
excluded.remote release archives: not marked verified unless bytes are retrieved and read-back hashed
